_comment: Nine Ridgeback-UR5s for coop_nine_apples_hall, in three teams of three.
Placed by room rather than pinned: the hall task has no authored robot
layout to reproduce, and place_robots spreads them through empty_room_0
on its own. Pin coordinates only when a scene was authored with them.
No scale, so each loads at its own full size -- 1.35 x 1.00 m for this
model. That is deliberate here and the opposite of the v4_s1_v4_ll
layout, which shrinks its robots to 0.5 because the V4 scene stages them
within half a metre of each other. empty_room_0 is large enough not to
need it, and full size is the honest default.
Worth watching: this robot's end effector is a suction cup with no
fingers, and its navigation sampler wants 1.25-1.85 m of clear floor
around a target, against roughly 0.6 m for an R1. Nine of them in one
room is a real test of whether that fits.
Three teams matter even under `individual`, which ignores the split:
the same file then runs broadcast_chain and centralized unchanged, with
three teams' worth of inter-team traffic.
